parameters.name: RuleAction
parameters.description:
The action that is performed when the rule is hit. Valid values:

*   **1**: alert
*   **2**: block

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the rule. You do not need to manually specify the ID.

parameters.name: RuleSwitch
parameters.description:
The switch of the rule. Valid values:

*   **0**: off
*   **1**: on

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The rule type. Valid values:

*   2: user-defined rules

> Only the value 2 is supported.

sub_parameters.name: AllNamespace
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include all namespaces. Valid values:

*   **0**: You can use the Namespaces parameter to specify the namespaces to include.
*   **1**: All namespaces are included.

sub_parameters.name: ClusterId
sub_parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~182997~~) operation to query the IDs of clusters.
